authenticate.doc: Verify an OTP (one-time password) for two-factor authentication. For anonymous sessions, authenticates using secret and code. For existing sessions, checks whether the OTP belongs to the current user and returns appropriate status.

vars.doc: Optional context object. May contain ident for cross-session detection.

returns.doc: Authentication result

status.doc: ALREADY_SIGNED_IN if the OTP belongs to the current user; CROSS_SIGNED_IN if it belongs to a different user; ALREADY_ONLINE if no OTP was found

current.doc: Email of the currently signed-in user (only present when status is CROSS_SIGNED_IN)

uid.doc: ID of the currently signed-in user (only present when status is CROSS_SIGNED_IN)

input.doc: The ident that was attempted (only present when status is CROSS_SIGNED_IN)

errors.message: secret or code parameter is missing

avatar.doc: Retrieve a user's avatar image file (PNG or SVG). Serves the raw image content directly. Returns an empty object if the user is not found or no avatar file exists on disk.

id.doc: ID of the user whose avatar to retrieve. Defaults to the current session user.

type.doc: Avatar variant type (e.g. vignette). Defaults to the VIGNETTE constant.

returns.doc: Raw image file content (PNG or SVG). Returns empty object if avatar does not exist.

check_drumate_exist.doc: Check whether a Drumee user exists by their ID or email address.

id.doc: User ID or email address to check

returns.doc: User existence record from drumate_exists procedure. Empty object if not found.

check_password.doc: Verify the current authenticated user's password against the stored hash. Used to confirm identity before performing sensitive account operations.

password.doc: Plain-text password to verify against the stored hash for the current user

returns.doc: Result from check_password_next procedure indicating whether the password matches

device_registration.doc: Register a mobile device for push notifications. Associates the device push token with the current user account and sets its status to active.

push_token.doc: Push notification token issued by the device platform (APNs or FCM)

returns.doc: Device registration result from device_registration procedure

errors.message: device_id, device_type, or push_token is missing

email_exists.doc: Check whether an email address is already registered in the system.

value.doc: Email address to check for existence

returns.doc: Result from email_exists procedure indicating whether the email is already registered

files_formats.doc: Retrieve the complete list of supported file formats with their extension, category, MIME type, and capability flags.

returns.doc: Array of file format records from the filecap table

category.doc: File category group (e.g. image, video, document)

capability.doc: Capability flags indicating supported operations for this file type

get_env.doc: Retrieve platform environment configuration for the current hub, including branding, feature flags, and platform-specific settings.

returns.doc: Platform environment configuration object from the env library

get_external_share.doc: Retrieve metadata about a publicly shared file or folder by its share ID.

share_id.doc: Unique identifier of the external share link

returns.doc: Share metadata from get_external_share procedure

get_hub.doc: Retrieve full hub configuration for the current domain, including custom stylesheets, font links, and font face declarations. Returns 404 if the hub hostname is not found.

returns.doc: Hub configuration object

stylesheets.doc: List of custom stylesheet file records from style_get_files procedure

fonts_links.doc: List of font link records from get_fonts_links procedure

fonts_faces.doc: List of font face CSS records from get_fonts_faces procedure

errors.message: Hub hostname is null or not configured

get_ident_availablility.doc: Check whether a username (ident) is available for new user registration. Note: method name preserves intentional legacy spelling.

ident.doc: Username or ident string to check for availability

returns.doc: Availability result from available_ident procedure

get_laguages.doc: Retrieve a paginated list of supported languages, optionally filtered by name. Note: method name preserves intentional legacy spelling.

value.doc: Language name filter string. Mutually usable with name parameter.

name.doc: Language name filter string. Mutually usable with value parameter.

returns.doc: Paginated list of language records from get_laguages procedure

guest_login.doc: Authenticate a guest user via a DMZ (public share) token. Handles password-protected shares, named guest access, and public room sessions. Returns combined session state and share metadata.

token.doc: DMZ share token identifying the public share to access

returns.doc: Combined guest session and share metadata

validity.doc: REQUIRED_PASSWORD if a password is needed but was not provided

require_name.doc: 1 if the public room requires the guest to provide a display name

require_password.doc: 1 if the share is protected by a password

is_public.doc: 1 if the share is publicly accessible without prior authentication

hours.doc: Share expiration in hours from DMZ settings

days.doc: Share expiration in days from DMZ settings

guest_name.doc: Display name of the guest user if already provided

returns.doc: No response body

hello.doc: Retrieve the current session user profile enriched with subscription plan details and live connection status. Commonly used on application load to verify session state.

returns.doc: Current user profile from get_user procedure, augmented with session fields

signed_in.doc: 1 if the user is fully signed in, 0 otherwise

plan_detail.doc: Current subscription plan renewal information from renewal_get_next procedure

ident_exists.doc: Check whether a given ident (username) is already registered in the system.

returns.doc: Result from ident_exists procedure

login.doc: Authenticate a user with username or email and password. If a session is already active, returns ALREADY_SIGNED_IN or CROSS_SIGNED_IN status instead of creating a new session. For non-email logins, the current vhost is used to resolve the username.

uid.doc: Username or email address (alias for ident)

ident.doc: Username or email address (alias for uid)

username.doc: Username (alias for ident, resolved against vhost)

vhost.doc: Virtual host override used to resolve non-email usernames in multi-tenant installations

returns.doc: Session result from session.signin

status.doc: ALREADY_SIGNED_IN if the same user is already logged in; CROSS_SIGNED_IN if a different user is already in session

current.doc: Email of the currently signed-in user (only when CROSS_SIGNED_IN)

uid.doc: ID of the currently signed-in user (only when CROSS_SIGNED_IN)

input.doc: The ident that was attempted (only when CROSS_SIGNED_IN)

errors.message: vars object with uid/ident and password is required

login_top.doc: Finalize a magic-link or OTP-based login flow. Validates the session OTP using the provided uid, code, and secret, then returns the full user profile.

id.doc: User ID to authenticate (alias for uid)

uid.doc: User ID to authenticate (alias for id)

code.doc: OTP code from the login link

secret.doc: OTP secret from the login link

returns.doc: Full user profile from get_user procedure after successful OTP validation

lookup_drumates.doc: Search for Drumee users by name with pagination. Used for user discovery and contact suggestions.

name.doc: Partial name or username to search. Defaults to empty string which returns all users.

returns.doc: Paginated list of matching drumate user records from lookup_drumates procedure

notification_count.doc: Get the total count of unread notifications for the current authenticated user.

returns.doc: Notification count result from yp_notification_count procedure

notification_list.doc: Get the full list of notifications received by the current authenticated user.

returns.doc: List of notification records from yp_notification_receive_list procedure

ping.doc: Connection health check endpoint. Supports three modes: debug (returns server verbosity and module state), test (returns request timing), and default (echoes the type value).

type.doc: Ping mode: debug returns server diagnostics, test returns timing data, omit or any other value returns type echo

nid.doc: Optional node ID (reserved for future use)

returns.doc: Response varies by type mode

verbosity.doc: Global server verbosity level (debug mode only)

modules.doc: Active debug module flags (debug mode only)

me.doc: Current user profile data (debug mode only)

t1.doc: Start timestamp in milliseconds (test mode only)

t2.doc: End timestamp in milliseconds (test mode only)

reset_forgot_password.doc: Reset a user's password using a validated forgot-password token. This is the final step of the password recovery flow, called after validate_forgot_password_token.

reset_session.doc: Reset the current session state and bind it to a WebSocket socket ID. Used to re-establish session context after a WebSocket reconnection.

socket_id.doc: WebSocket session ID to bind to the current HTTP session

returns.doc: Confirmed session identifiers after reset

errors.message: socket_id is required, or the current session ID is null or undefined

send_forgot_password_token.doc: Initiate the forgot-password flow by sending a one-time reset token to the user's registered email address. First step of the password recovery sequence.

sys_var.doc: Retrieve a system-level configuration variable by name from the sys_var table.

name.doc: Name of the system variable to retrieve

returns.doc: System variable record matching the given name from the sys_var table

signin.doc: Alias for login. Authenticate a user with username or email and password.

tutorial.doc: Retrieve a single tutorial entry by name.

name.doc: Name or identifier of the tutorial to retrieve

returns.doc: Tutorial record from get_tutorial procedure
All records from the tutorial table

username_exists.doc: Check whether a username is already registered within the current domain (resolved from the request vhost).

value.doc: Username to check within the current domain

returns.doc: Result from get_user_in_domain procedure for the current vhost

validate_forgot_password_token.doc: Validate a password-reset token received via email. Second step of the password recovery flow, called before reset_forgot_password.

verify_email.doc: Verify a user's email address using a hashed email value and a one-time verification token sent to that address.

uid.doc: User ID whose email to verify. Defaults to the current session user.

email.doc: Hashed email address used as the verification target

token.doc: One-time verification token sent to the user's email

returns.doc: Returns empty body on success

errors.message: Verification failed: email or token is invalid or expired

host_exists.doc: Check whether a hub (domain) exists by its hostname. Returns the hub record if found, or an empty result if not.

host.doc: Hostname to look up in the hub registry via get_hub procedure

returns.doc: Hub record from get_hub procedure, or null/empty if not found

public_key.doc: Retrieve the server's RSA public key in PEM format. Used by clients to encrypt sensitive data (e.g. passwords) before transmission.

returns.doc: RSA public key in PEM format served as text/plain from crypto/public.pem
